customer_question: Our quote request specified BR/EDR/BLE for this module, but is the actual registration going to cover BLE only?
question_variants: Does combining these two QDIDs change which Bluetooth modes our registration actually covers?
Can we still register as BR/EDR/BLE if one of the referenced QDIDs is BLE-only?
Why would our registration scope differ from what we put on the quote-request form?
actual_issue: The customer's quote-request form specified a BR/EDR/BLE (dual-mode) registration for their module-based product, but one of the two QDIDs that needed to be referenced together (the Controller Subsystem QDID) was actually a BLE-only module, meaning the resulting combined registration would necessarily be a BLE-only product registration rather than the BR/EDR/BLE registration the customer had specified.
plain_english_explanation: A product's actual Bluetooth registration scope is constrained by what the underlying chip components actually support, not by what the customer writes on a quote-request form. If one of the certified pieces being referenced -- in this case, the radio/controller-level QDID -- only supports the newer, lower-power BLE mode and not the older Classic Bluetooth (BR/EDR) mode, then the combined registration can only be filed as a BLE-only product, regardless of what was originally requested.
consultant_answer: QDID [Host] needs to be referenced in combination with QDID [Controller Subsystem], but since the Controller Subsystem QDID (199354) is a BLE-only module, the registration combining both will be a BLE-only product registration -- not the BR/EDR/BLE registration stated in the quote-request form.
decision_logic: The actual mode scope (BR/EDR/BLE vs. BLE-only) of a combined registration is determined by the actual capabilities of the underlying referenced QDIDs (particularly the Controller Subsystem/radio-level QDID), not by what the customer specifies on the quote-request form; if the Controller Subsystem QDID is BLE-only, the resulting registration is necessarily BLE-only regardless of the originally-requested scope.
final_recommendation: Before finalizing a quote or registration scope, check the actual mode capability of the Controller Subsystem QDID being referenced, and correct the registration's stated scope (e.g., from BR/EDR/BLE to BLE-only) to match the underlying hardware's real capability rather than the customer's original quote-request assumption.
risk_if_done_wrong: Proceeding with a registration scoped as BR/EDR/BLE when the underlying Controller Subsystem QDID is actually BLE-only would misrepresent the product's actual certified capability, requiring correction before the registration could be validly completed.
